message: シエスタ

name: Synn
message: 「Ahh, Lolotte's tiered bento... that was so good」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-You're still baskin' in the afterglow? It's already after school, y'know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, where do ya think you're goin'? That's the total opposite direction from the old school building, ain't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Today, I'm going to take a breather up on the hill before starting Student Council activities.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ya tired or somethin'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope. I'm going somewhere quiet with no one around so I can reminisce all over again. About that tiered bento...」

name: Synn
message: 「If I can etch that deliciousness into my memory, I'll be able to survive on plain white rice alone for the next ten days.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell I'm doin' that! Make proper meals for me!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Quit swoonin' over it!!」
Oh? Those two are...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wait up, Azel-saaan...!」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no obligation to wait.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Where are you going?」

name: Azel
message: 「Somewhere.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Euu... I can't tell where that is.」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't follow me.」
Surprisingly, there were familiar faces in the plaza on the hill.
They're in different grades, so how do they know each other? Azel is striding briskly ahead while Lolotte toddles along behind. Their paces don't match at all.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there, what are you two up to?」

name: Azel
message: 「Breathing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hiii♪ Please join us too, President. Let's have a tea party with Azel-san.」

name: Azel
message: 「Beats me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excited, excited. We have sweets, too. My butler made them by hand. Clap, clap.」

name: Azel
message: 「Human hands are teeming with germs.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gramps's hands are clean!」
L-Lolotte... You're so mad your wings popped out.

name: Azel
message: 「...Is that so?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, it is!」

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooooh, you finally understand!」

name: Azel
message: 「I understand, so go home. Take those sweets and leave. You should know why.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hieek?! Never mind about me! I had these sweets made because I wanted to eat them with you, Azel-san!」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not interested.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please wai--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauah!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaaaaa!! Tontoroooo~」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte! Did you cut your hands? Does anything hurt?」

name: Azel
message: 「Is this my fault?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hic... ugh! I tripped all on my own. It's not your fault, Azel-san.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniffle... sob...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, lend me some cellophane tape. You always carry repair tools around, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'll help too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「R-Really? Sparkle, sparkle~\s07」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not lying. So put your wings away.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hiuu... I-I-I-I-I'm not an angel or anything!」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't cry. If you lose unnecessary moisture, replenishing your jelly will be a pain.」
The three of us--Azel, Lolotte, and I--sat down in the grass on the hill and began sticking the pieces of Tontoro back together.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz」

name: Azel
message: 「It stuck... No... Hand that over」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean this fragment?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz」

name: Azel
message: 「It will be fixed soon」
Exhausted from crying, Lolotte is breathing softly in her sleep with her head resting on Azel's lap.
Lolotte hadn't gotten permission; just like a young child worn out from playing who suddenly lies down and falls asleep, she had abruptly collapsed right onto Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「Why are you pulling the corners of your mouth?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What do you mean?」

name: Azel
message: 「Why are you pulling the corners of your mouth upward? Is that movement some kind of signal?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, seeing the two of you was just so heartwarming that my face couldn't help but soften」

name: Azel
message: 「So that is what is called a smile. Understood」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, sweets... zzz, zzz」

name: Azel
message: 「You like sweets very much, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's a strange way to ask, isn't it?」

name: Azel
message: 「You eat them. And keep it a secret」

name: Synn
message: 「Why? You're the one Lolotte offered them to, Azel, aren't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「Never mind me. This one is your companion, is she not? Then do as I say」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, we're the same, aren't we... zzz, zzz」

name: Azel
message: 「We are not」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Wha...?!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nothing at all. I'll gladly take the sweets」

name: Azel
message: 「I see」
I quickly compose myself and accept the sweets that Lolotte had forcefully pressed into Azel's hands.
The reason I let out a gasp of surprise... It had to be a trick of the light. It wasn't like I saw them clearly, the way I can with Lolotte's wings.
And yet...
It was only for a brief moment. The sight of Azel letting Lolotte sleep looked just like the base of a massive, towering tree deep within a forest.
An angel sleeping among the powerful, moss-green roots of a giant tree, soft sunlight filtering through the leaves dancing across white feathers
Why did I end up seeing Azel like that?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, let's eat together... zzz, zzz」

name: Azel
message: 「I already ate.」
I see, so that's why Azel gave me the sweets.
Could it be that Azel doesn't have a sweet tooth?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, heehee...」
Even after Tontoro returned to its original form, Azel kept giving Lolotte a lap pillow until she woke up.
